hero.headline: Olasupo Abigael Tomilola:
hero.bio: Capturing timeless milestones, vintage-inspired love stories, and clean editorial portraits across Ibadan, Ekiti, and Southwest Nigeria.
hero.philosophy: Atmosphere over mere documentation — crafting emotion through intentional light, honest posing, and rich, natural skin tones.

testimonials.quote: Abigael captured our entire traditional and white wedding day — from the introduction ceremony in the morning to the evening reception — with such care and presence. The gallery came back rich in colour, deeply emotional, and full of candid moments we didn't even know she caught. Our purple-themed day looked exactly like a magazine spread.
testimonials.name: Adewale & Mojirayo

testimonials.quote: I booked Abigael for my EKSU convocation and was blown away. She worked quickly in the outdoor heat, found the most flattering natural light on campus, and delivered portraits that look like professional brand shots. My parents framed three of them. This was the best investment I made for my graduation day.
testimonials.name: Funmilola Adeyemi

testimonials.quote: My birthday shoot in the studio was an experience from start to finish. Abigael has a way of making you feel completely at ease in front of the camera — she directed me through poses so naturally that I forgot I was even being photographed. The colour grading and retouching on the final images were impeccable: luminous, clean, and 100% true to my skin tone.
testimonials.name: Olawunmi Bankole

about.bio: I am Olasupo Abigael Tomilola, the creative behind @oat_graphy, a photographer based in Southwest Nigeria specializing in weddings, milestone graduations, and expressive studio portraiture. Whether directing a vintage silhouette concept or documenting a bustling wedding day in Ibadan or Ekiti, I focus on clean lighting, authentic emotion, and natural skin tones. Every gallery featured above is a live client or creative portfolio project ready for viewing.
